skill_name: Compare and contrast two type of programming language.
workflow: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Functional Programming (FP) are two different paradigms for programming languages. OOP is focused on objects and utilizes methods and data to manipulate them. It is useful in modeling real-world entities like people, places and things. Functional programming is based on the concept of functions and uses functions to manipulate data. It is useful in creating programs that are easy to modify and maintain.
